items.markdown:
![Best hotels in Bangkok | Telegraph Travel](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07281357-1672-0139-0000-2a91454a0b5c:4)
The top luxury hotels in Bangkok include the historic Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok , the artistic [Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River](https://www.fourseasons.com/bangkok/) , and the sleek [The Okura Prestige Bangkok](https://www.okurabangkok.com/).[[1]](https://www.trip.com/moments/detail/bangkok-191-120205921/)[[2]](https://www.trip.com/moments/detail/bangkok-191-120830424/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MQglDh9g9rE&t=125)

Riverfront Sanctuaries

- **Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok** : Legendary riverside service, classic Thai elegance, and world-class dining established over 145 years.
- **Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River** : Modern high-design oasis, museum-quality art, and a stunning riverside pool.
- **Capella Bangkok** : Intimate riverfront resort featuring private villas and the renowned Auriga Wellness spa.[](https://www.forbestravelguide.com/destinations/bangkok-thailand) [[1]](https://www.forbestravelguide.com/destinations/bangkok-thailand)[[2]](https://www.cntraveller.com/gallery/hotels-in-bangkok)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1AZaZ3zGg1c&t=89)[[4]](https://www.travelup.com/en-gb/blog/best-hotels-in-bangkok)[[5]](https://voyeglobal.com/hotels-to-stay-in-bangkok/)

Urban and Skytrain-Adjacent Luxury

- **The Okura Prestige Bangkok** : Japanese-inspired minimalism, a dramatic 24th-floor infinity pool, and direct covered access to Phloen Chit BTS station.
- **Rosewood Bangkok** : Striking architectural design reflecting the traditional Thai greeting, complete with the vinyl-heavy Lennon's bar.
- **Park Hyatt Bangkok** : Located atop Central Embassy with minimalist apartment-style rooms and a quiet 40-meter pool.[](https://www.cntraveler.com/gallery/best-hotels-in-bangkok) [[1]](https://www.cntraveler.com/gallery/best-hotels-in-bangkok)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MQglDh9g9rE&t=125)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pA0g5OuEn-I&t=80)[[4]](https://guide.michelin.com/ca/en/article/travel/best-hotels-in-bangkok)[[5]](https://www.okurabangkok.com/blog/staying-at-the-okura-prestige-bangkok-bangkok-city-centre-luxury-five-star-hotel)

If you would like to narrow down your choice, tell me:

- Are you looking for a **riverfront view** or a **city center/shopping district** location?
- What **amenities** matter most to you (e.g., Michelin-dining, large spas, or family-friendly spaces)?
